content:
精神续作：
["楼梯拱门" By eclipsion13](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/stair-arches)
["圆形树木" By Motschen](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/round-trees-mc-vanilla-1-8-1-13)

此资源包会将所有双层堆叠的非木质台阶转换为柱子，并将非木质的倒置楼梯转换为拱门！

垂直堆叠时，紫珀柱和石英柱同样会被转换！
![石头！](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/zK3yV1gk/images/a209a1e13a8721bf29a4c4de9b98e11156198666.png)
